paper_record.title: Magnon band splitting without altermagnetism in CuF2
paper_record.abstract: Conclusive identification of an altermagnetic state requires going beyond mere symmetry arguments. We illustrate this in a combined computational and experimental study of the rutile-like material CuF$_2$, which is on the list of predicted altermagnets. Using ab initio and linear spin-wave calculations supplied by magnetization measurements, we show that CuF$_2$ in its experimental monoclinic structure can be described by a spin-$\frac12$ model of weakly coupled square-lattice layers with the in-plane coupling $J_1\simeq 115$ K and two synergistic antiferromagnetic interplane couplings amounting to 4% and 8% of $J_1$, respectively. Driven by long-range superexchange, these interlayer couplings are oblique to the square planes, resulting in the unit-cell doubling in the magnetically ordered state, thus effectively suppressing any altermagnetic band splitting. Concurrently, we identify unusually strong Dzyaloshinskii-Moriya interactions, $|\mathbf D|/J_1\simeq 0.3$, that produce spin canting and, together with order-by-disorder effect, pin the Néel vector to the crystallographic $b$-axis. Additionally, DM anisotropy promotes magnon band splitting, but these bands remain non-chiral. Our results highlight the importance of relativistic effects even in $3d$ magnets with altermagnetic symmetries.

one_sentence_summary.zh: 研究表明单斜CuF2中的磁子能带分裂源于强Dzyaloshinskii-Moriya相对论相互作用而非交代磁性。
one_sentence_summary.en: The study demonstrates that magnon band splitting in monoclinic CuF2 originates from strong Dzyaloshinskii-Moriya relativistic interactions rather than altermagnetism.

problem.zh: 澄清预言候选材料CuF2在真实单斜畸变结构下的实际磁基态、磁子能带分裂来源以及是否真正具备交代磁性。
problem.en: To clarify the true magnetic ground state, origin of magnon band splitting, and presence of altermagnetism in predicted candidate CuF2 within its realistic monoclinic structure.

approach.zh: 结合从头算（DFT+U）、量子蒙特卡洛、精确对角化、线性自旋波理论以及磁化强度实验测量。
approach.en: Combined ab initio calculations (DFT+U), quantum Monte Carlo, exact diagonalization, linear spin-wave theory, and magnetization measurements.

main_takeaway.zh: CuF2由于层间耦合导致磁胞加倍而消除了交代磁自旋分裂，但其极强的DM相互作用（|D|/J1约0.3）诱导自旋倾斜并导致了非手性的磁子能带分裂。
main_takeaway.en: Magnetic unit-cell doubling suppresses true altermagnetic splitting in CuF2, but strong DM interactions (|D|/J1 ~ 0.3) drive spin canting and produce relativistic, non-chiral magnon band splitting.

why_it_matters.zh: 揭示了单纯依靠晶体结构对称性判定交代磁性的局限性，并证明相对论DM相互作用能在3d磁体中产生类似交代磁性的磁子分裂特征。
why_it_matters.en: Highlights the limitations of relying purely on symmetry arguments to identify altermagnets and shows that relativistic DM interactions in 3d magnets can mimic altermagnetic magnon splitting.

reason.zh: 澄清了CuF2中磁子分裂的非交代磁性（相对论DM）起源，纠正了先前的对称性误判。
reason.en: Clarified the non-altermagnetic (relativistic DM) origin of magnon band splitting in CuF2, resolving prior symmetry-based misconceptions.

reason.zh: 文章对凝物理热点前沿（交代磁性概念的适用边界）给出了具有重要指示意义的理论与实验澄清。
reason.en: Provides an impactful theoretical and experimental clarification on a prominent topic (boundaries of altermagnetism) in condensed matter physics.
